name: Takeuchi Narumi
source:
The main character's childhood friend and college girlfriend, she was raised in a kendo (Japanese fencing) dojo. She is a stoic girl who hates losing and doesn't take jokes very well, but is easily embarrassed, especially during sex. Her hobbies include kendo and caring for her long black hair.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/bazooka-cafe.html]JAST USA[/url]]
